rules.rationale: The canonical kernel cannot depend on verification, provider, orchestration, runtime, or product-domain implementations. daedalus.schemas is listed because it is a legacy compatibility facade that re-exports kernel contracts alongside orchestration and runtime records: importing it pulls those outer layers into every kernel process, so the kernel names the owning module under daedalus.kernel.contracts instead. This checker observes direct import syntax only; a leak through an unlisted intermediate module stays invisible to it, which is why daedalus.orchestration is listed even though no kernel module imports it today.
Runtime admission consumes neutral receipts and must not call their gate producers.
The event spine is canonical infrastructure and cannot depend on product, orchestration, evaluator, provider, runtime, or interface implementations.
